title: How to Be Less Useful: The Joy of Inefficiency
description: A delightful book about reclaiming pleasure in mid-life—a potent mix of self-help and memoir, from one of today’s wittiest, wisest voices. “A hilarious chillout manual for cool people who want to be more than their appointments and obligations.” —Samantha Irby "I have done everything right, and I have missed everything." Think about what we choose to cut out or overlook as we approach the deep end of adulthood: Dessert. Naps. Pretty underwear. Sweaty dancing. “Pointless” hangs with the people we love most. And then, activities that used to be fun somehow lose their luster, usually in the decade between thirty and forty: summer vacation (exhaustion), stay-in-touch texting (bandwidth), finding the perfect restaurant (the algorithm). When did our lives become entirely about efficiency and optimization? Priyanka Mattoo shares her journey toward being less useful, delivering life lessons without an ounce of preachiness or pressure. She looks at where pleasure begins and what it serves. Did you know karaoke can cure a stomachache? Or that Paddington Bear is a stealth lifestyle guru? Or that nobody actually asked you to do that labor-intensive thing you begrudgingly did? With self-deprecating humor, devastating insight, and bracing honesty, Priyanka shows us how to step out of the grind as a friend, as a partner, even as a parent, and welcome joy back into our lives without burning it all down. What if, instead of being useful, we could all learn how to be happier, lighter, more present, more engaged? title: How to Be Less Useless: An Adulting Guide for People Who Were Never Properly Taught Anythi
description: How to Be Less Useless An Adulting Guide for People Who Were Never Properly Taught Anything So... you're an adult now. Nobody gave you an instruction manual. Nobody explained why everything costs so much, how you're supposed to keep your house clean, what the hell a credit score actually is, or why the washing machine suddenly sounds like it's trying to escape. Don't worry. You're not the only one. How to Be Less Useless is a funny, practical guide to all the everyday stuff you're somehow expected to know as an adult. Inside, you'll learn how to: Stop being permanently skint Cook something other than toast Survive laundry without destroying your clothes Deal with bills before they become a problem Clean your home before it becomes a biological experiment Handle basic DIY without making things worse Understand credit scores and your bank account Know what to look for before signing contracts Deal with broken stuff without immediately panicking Have people over without pretending your house is a hotel This isn't a boring lecture about becoming a "better person." It's a guide to becoming slightly less useless . No perfection. No corporate bullshit. No pretending you've got your entire life figured out. Just practical advice, common sense, and a bit of humour for anyone who's ever thought: "Why the fuck did nobody teach me this?" Welcome to adulthood. You're probably going to be fine. title: The Book of Not Entirely Useful Advice
description: From acclaimed writer A.F. Harrold comes a riotous poetry collection that encourages readers to think critically--perfect for fans of Shel Silverstein! Packed with silly rhymes and witty wordplay, A.F. Harrold's poetry is positively bursting with fun--and advice. But it's not always the most useful. . . Never apologize to a door you've walked into, unless it's a really special door. Don't serve a cat soup when the cat wants jelly. Tomato soup won't fill a feline belly. Don't put a rock in a roll, unless you hate having teeth. Among the seemingly nonsensical stanzas on onions, sausages, and kilted koalas are exercises in critical thinking--what advice should readers follow, and what should they dismiss? Harrold's short, clever poems work seamlessly alongside Mini Grey's vibrant art to create visual gags that will have readers in stitches. Both silly and poignant, this book is perfect for curious readers, poets, and cabbages everywhere!  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8"]', '#CardInstanceOtlzGzNaBS0Vb_otJUFrmQ')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:65vw}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K{height:15vh;margin-top:10vh;text-align:center}.

title: I Want To Be a Useless Person: A Guide to Living Fully by Doing Less
description: What if the most radical thing you could do was absolutely nothing? We live in a world that measures your worth by your output. Hustle harder. Do more. Sleep less. Be productive — or be forgotten. But what if the whole system is broken? I Want To Be a Useless Person is a quiet rebellion against the grind. Written with warmth, honesty, and a little humor, this book dismantles the myth that your value is tied to your productivity — and invites you to imagine a life that feels less like a race and more like home. Across 21 chapters, you will learn to: Unlearn the hustle gospel that has been sold to you since childhood Reclaim rest, boredom, and stillness as acts of courage — not laziness Rebuild your relationships, creativity, and sense of self outside of achievement Say no — to the grind, to guilt, and to a life you never actually chose This is not a book about giving up. It's a book about waking up. To slower mornings. Deeper connections. A version of yourself that doesn't need to earn the right to exist. You are not a machine. title: This Book Is Not Helping: 100 Completely Unnecessary Topics - Illustrated Colour Edition
description: Finally, a book with absolutely no intention of improving your life. A dragon joins accounting. A snail robs a bank. The full stop is murdered, and the commas have been acting suspiciously. This Book Is Not Helping contains 100 short pieces of absurdist humour: impossible instructions, terrible products, strange conversations, miniature disasters, and official announcements from people who should never have been given a stamp. There are recipes you cannot cook, places you should not visit, and a dinosaur whose bus journey creates several unexpected exits. Read it in order, open it at random, or leave it somewhere conspicuous and hope a guest becomes concerned. No plot. No lesson. No useful information.
